The structure of Sr4Ce4Bi2O18 (Sr2Ce2BiO9) is monoclinic with space group C2/m (No. 15), containing 28 atoms per unit cell across seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Bi centers have eight O neighbors; Sr centers display four O neighbors each. O-centered octahedra share edges with Ce octahedra and corners with one another, and corner-sharing also occurs between Bi 8-vertex polyhedra and Ce octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
